how: Read by the reviewer of this run from the documents the job pulled, after the job ran. Every quote is checked word for word against the stored text of the document it names (tools/assemble.py); the figures beside them are from the same documents' tables.

reads.says: The 2025 profit did not come from the business. Operations lost $145.9M by the prospectus's own table ($145.3M in the vendor's copy); a single gain of $363.3M on a liability made the year positive ($237.8M).

quotes.text: a gain of $363.3 million recognized upon extinguishment of the forward contract liability during 2025

reads.says: Of the $450.5M loss in the quarter to 30 Jun 2026, $377.0M was pay in stock, most of it set off by the listing.

quotes.text: Non-cash charges consisted primarily of $386.6 million of stock-based compensation expense, $46.3 million of amortization of customer warrant assets

reads.says: Hardware made 2% (34% a year before), cloud 20% (26%). The company's own reason: customer warrants charged against sales, and pay in stock tied to the listing.

quotes.text: Hardware gross margin decreased to 2% for the three months ended June 30, 2026, compared to 34% for the same period in 2025
The decreases were primarily attributable to the amortization of customer warrant assets as a reduction of revenue and IPO-related stock-based compensation expense and related tax costs.

reads.says: On the call the company gave "core" sales of $209.9M for the quarter; its 10-Q reports $180.1M. Warrants given to customers are charged against reported sales, and $1.13bn of them are still on the balance sheet to be charged.

quotes.text: Core revenue was $209.9 million, up 103% year-over-year.
The customer warrant asset will be recognized as a reduction of revenue in proportion to the related revenue recognized.

reads.says: In the prospectus the company expected gross profit to fall in the near term. Three months later its 10-Q expects it to rise.

quotes.text: We expect overall gross profit will decrease in absolute dollars in the near term
We expect overall gross profit will increase in absolute dollars in the near term

reads.says: $25bn of contracted sales still to be delivered — none of it from AWS or another large cloud company yet.

quotes.text: our $25 billion in RPO does not reflect any backlog of business from AWS or any other hyperscaler at this time

reads.says: Two related customers were 86% of 2025 sales (G42 24%, MBZUAI 62%). OpenAI is the new large one; the company expects its share to fall over time.

quotes.text: accounted for 24.0% and 85.0% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024
OpenAI will shrink as a percentage of our revenue over time
